title: Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow - Dance Hall ~ Basement (Boss Room)
description:
Wine stored in old barrels seen during the boss fight against the Giant Golem, from Castlevania: Aria of Sorrow. Compared to the source material, I had to be quite creative in how to loop the background, since the Game Boy Advance resolution is smaller. A good fit for wine cellars, in general.

Please do credit me if you use this submission, since it took me a lot of effort to assemble this graphic and make it look consistently good. Thanks!
